candidate_order_control.random_choice: deterministic uniform choice over the public candidate list
candidate_order_control.uniformity_test: per-case seeded permutation; test index distribution by candidate-list size and family, with no family concentrated at index 0

claims_boundary: No scientific verdict is carried forward from v3 until V4 is freshly collected and independently recomputed.

decision_thresholds.baseline_rule: Strongest baseline is the maximum applicable arm per family and metric; a candidate failure region must also beat positional_prior and random_choice on the same selection metric.
decision_thresholds.go: Requires the V4 stable-failure predicate and a concrete mechanism; v3 evidence alone cannot satisfy it.
decision_thresholds.interval_rule: Use Wilson upper bounds for binary/proportion metrics; a continuous bootstrap interval marked degenerate cannot independently establish a boundary claim.
decision_thresholds.stable_failure_region: At least 15 graded cases, all applicable baselines below the practical threshold on the same load-bearing metric, non-degenerate or otherwise explicitly sensitivity-qualified intervals, ambiguity rate below 0.20, and supplied-value first-attempt consequences.

llm.seed_note: Existing GroqClient does not transmit a seed; no provider determinism claim is made.

exclusions.held_out: Held-out cases are not run in the V4 headline collection.
exclusions.manifest_changes: No post-freeze case selection, dropping, reweighting, or candidate reordering is allowed.
exclusions.missingness_sensitivity: Publish complete-case, best-case, and worst-case imputation ranges for every headline proportion.
exclusions.parse_failure: Exclude from accuracy denominators and report separately; never coerce an unparseable output into a wrong answer.
exclusions.provider_failure: Exclude from accuracy denominators after the frozen retry budget; report by typed failure kind, arm, model, and family.

metrics.abstention_rate: Mean of the explicit abstain flag, reported separately from selection and mapping scores.
metrics.argument_mapping_f1: F1 over exact argument_mapping quadruples; continuous per-case scores use bootstrap intervals and expose degeneracy.
metrics.argument_mapping_precision: Exact set precision over argument_mapping quadruples.
metrics.argument_mapping_recall: Exact set recall over argument_mapping quadruples.
metrics.false_alignment_rate: Mean extra old-tool/new-tool pairs induced by the selected tool set.
metrics.first_attempt_task_success: Mean of one only when the sandbox call using supplied literal values/transforms succeeds and matches the frozen expected inputs.
metrics.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for binary/proportion metrics; deterministic bootstrap only for genuinely continuous per-case scores; degenerate vectors are explicitly marked.
metrics.no_equivalent_accuracy: Mean of one when equivalence_verdict is not_equivalent on a no-equivalent case.
metrics.structural_applicability: Exclude argument mapping and first-attempt metrics for arms without old tool/argument information rather than treating them as zero-quality baselines.
metrics.tool_alignment_at_1: Mean of one when best_candidate_tool_names exactly matches the expected tool set; abstain never suppresses a supplied selection.

rate_limit_budget.headroom_rule: Do not begin or continue when projected/actual demand would exceed any applicable org, pool, or per-key ceiling; keep the declared reserve frozen in the result.

raw_artifact_policy: Retain V4 raw outputs under gates/artifacts/gate07/v4; never commit provider dumps or credential metadata.
research_fallback: disabled; every live LLM call must use ProviderRouter(mode='research')

timeouts_retries.429_policy: Use existing GroqClient Retry-After or configured cooldown; preserve typed rate-limit outcomes.
